notes.title: House Fighters: Total Mess - a new upcoming project from Revulo Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956695/14d5478821b937dbc615c808b80239724affdf0a.png[/img]

[b]House Fighters: Total Mess [/b]is a playful arcade dogfighting game. Hop into a toy plane, zip through cozy rooms, and turn everyday objects into thrilling battlegrounds. No complicated controls, just pure, lighthearted aerial chaos. Weave between bookshelves, dodge towering lamps, and outmaneuver tiny enemies in fast-paced, feel-good combat.


[list]
[*]Weave, and strike in high-speed dogfights. Use rockets, bombs, and even household items to outmaneuver your toy-sized foes.
[*]Customize your fighter with playful stickers, wacky weapons, and unexpected upgrades. Experiment and find the perfect loadout for every mission.
[*]Chase, dodge, and loop through playful missions where every room holds a new challenge. Sneak past towering obstacles, weave through tight spaces, and take on clever little foes in fast, lighthearted dogfights.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot fixes update
notes.content:
Key Fixes:
Motion Blur: Say goodbye to the annoying motion blur! We fine-tuned the visuals to ensure a clearer, smoother experience.
Puck Stuck Bug: The dreaded puck-stuck glitch is no more. The action will now flow without interruptions.
Ice Artefacts: Visual artefacts on the ice have been cleared up.
Performance Enhancements: We also introduced performance improvements to make the game run more efficiently.

notes.title: Hello world !
notes.content:
Welcome, gamers and indie game enthusiasts!

We are excited to introduce Revulo Games - an independent development studio passionate about creating unique and engaging experiences in the world of gaming.

We are thrilled to have the opportunity to present our projects to a wider audience on the Steam platform. Our games combine original mechanics and a unique visual style, which we hope will appeal to both experienced gamers and new enthusiasts of indie games.

Follow our profile on Steam to stay up to date with our upcoming projects and updates. We can't wait to share our games with you and hear your feedback!

Our first game from the casual sports games series is Casual Sport Series: Hockey. 

[b]Here are its main features:[/b]
- Simple and intuitive gameplay, accessible to players of all ages
- Unique graphics
- Quick matches perfect for playing in short sessions
- Various game modes, including quick match and tournaments
- Ability to play with friends in local multiplayer mode or Remote Play Together

[h2]This is how it started:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210364/c40203b1fd41b1ff38b51cdf576b76e6cc7edb69.gif[/img]

[h2]And this is how the game looks after half a year of work:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210364/c885b3c21755adc14011c8f441119dd1d628901e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210364/f0ec084efdfac0d435a82229cf1ebbdb6612962f.gif[/img]


[h3]Planned updates in the near future:[/h3]
- Improvement of the automatic aiming system in passes and shots
- Adding an option to disable automatic aiming in settings
- Improving game performance
- Fixing minor bugs



Thank you to everyone who decided to buy our game! Your support is invaluable to us and motivates us to continue working on improving and developing our project.

We strongly encourage you to share your impressions, opinions, and suggestions with us. What do you like? What could we change or improve? Your feedback is extremely valuable to us and will help us make the game even better.

You can leave your opinions in the comments section on Steam or through our social media. Every opinion is important to us and will be carefully analyzed by our team.

Once again, thank you for your trust and support. Together we create the Revulo Games community, and we can't wait to hear what you think about our game!

Best regards,
The Revulo Games Team
